@@ -0,0 +1,279 @@
+import io
+import json
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
+
+sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", line_buffering=True)
+
+BASE = "http://localhost:8000"
+PUBLIC_PAGES = [
+    "/index.html",
+    "/pages/ataskaitos.html",
+    "/pages/bendra-info.html",
+    "/pages/dirvezemis.html",
+    "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html",
+    "/pages/oro.html",
+    "/pages/prenumerata.html",
+    "/pages/privatumo-politika.html",
+    "/pages/slapuku-politika.html",
+    "/pages/truksmas.html",
+    "/pages/vadovas.html",
+    "/pages/vanduo.html",
+    "/pages/zeldynai.html",
+    "/pages/zemelapis.html",
+]
+EXPECTED_NAV = [
+    "Automatinių stotelių duomenys",
+    "Aplinkos triukšmo monitoringas",
+    "Dirvožemio monitoringas",
+    "Paviršinio vandens monitoringas",
+    "Gyvosios gamtos monitoringas",
+    "Želdynų ir želdinių monitoringas",
+]
+
+failures = []
+results = {
+    "deep_links": {},
+    "navigation": {},
+    "multiselects": {},
+    "public_pages": {},
+    "screenshots": {},
+}
+
+
+def check(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        failures.append(message)
+
+
+def open_page(context, path, wait_ms=650):
+    page = context.new_page()
+    errors = []
+    page.on("console", lambda message: errors.append(f"console: {message.text}") if message.type == "error" else None)
+    page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append(f"pageerror: {error}"))
+    page.goto(f"{BASE}{path}", wait_until="load")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(wait_ms)
+    return page, errors
+
+
+def selected_values(page, selector):
+    return page.locator(selector).evaluate("select => [...select.selectedOptions].map(option => option.value)")
+
+
+def component_state(page, selector):
+    return page.locator(selector).evaluate(
+        """select => {
+            const component = select.nextElementSibling;
+            return {
+              options: select.options.length,
+              selected: [...select.selectedOptions].map(option => option.value),
+              rows: component?.querySelectorAll('.multiselect__option').length || 0,
+              checked: [...(component?.querySelectorAll('.multiselect__option input:checked') || [])].map(input => input.value),
+              count: component?.querySelector('.multiselect__count')?.textContent || '',
+              visible: Boolean(component && component.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0),
+              nativeWidth: select.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+              inert: select.inert,
+            };
+        }"""
+    )
+
+
+def choose_reducing_district(page, district_selector, sites_selector, initial_count):
+    values = page.locator(district_selector).locator("option").evaluate_all("options => options.map(option => option.value).filter(value => value !== 'all')")
+    for value in values:
+        page.select_option(district_selector, value)
+        page.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        count = page.locator(sites_selector).evaluate("select => select.options.length")
+        if count != initial_count:
+            return {"value": value, "count": count}
+    return None
+
+
+def exercise_multiselect(page, sites_selector, status_selector, chart_selector, table_selector, district_selector=None):
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => document.querySelector(selector)?.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('multiselect')", sites_selector)
+    initial = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(initial["visible"], f"{sites_selector}: custom list is not visible")
+    check(initial["options"] == initial["rows"], f"{sites_selector}: option/row count mismatch ({initial['options']} / {initial['rows']})")
+    check(sorted(initial["selected"]) == sorted(initial["checked"]), f"{sites_selector}: initial native/custom state differs")
+    check(initial["nativeWidth"] <= 1.1 and initial["inert"], f"{sites_selector}: native select is not visually hidden and inert")
+
+    component = page.locator(f"{sites_selector} + .multiselect")
+    first_checked = component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first
+    before = {
+        "status": page.locator(status_selector).inner_text(),
+        "table_rows": page.locator(f"{table_selector} tbody tr").count(),
+        "chart_sets": page.locator(chart_selector).evaluate("canvas => canvas._kmsChart?.data.datasets.length ?? -1"),
+    }
+    toggled = False
+    if first_checked.count():
+        value = first_checked.get_attribute("value")
+        first_checked.uncheck()
+        page.wait_for_function("([selector, old]) => document.querySelector(selector)?.textContent !== old", [status_selector, before["status"]])
+        after = {
+            "status": page.locator(status_selector).inner_text(),
+            "table_rows": page.locator(f"{table_selector} tbody tr").count(),
+            "chart_sets": page.locator(chart_selector).evaluate("canvas => canvas._kmsChart?.data.datasets.length ?? -1"),
+        }
+        native_after = selected_values(page, sites_selector)
+        check(value not in native_after, f"{sites_selector}: uncheck did not update native select")
+        check(after["table_rows"] != before["table_rows"], f"{sites_selector}: table did not update after uncheck")
+        check(after["chart_sets"] != before["chart_sets"], f"{sites_selector}: chart did not update after uncheck")
+        component.locator(f'.multiselect__option input[value="{value}"]').check()
+        page.wait_for_function("([selector, old]) => document.querySelector(selector)?.textContent === old", [status_selector, before["status"]])
+        toggled = True
+
+    district = None
+    if district_selector:
+        district = choose_reducing_district(page, district_selector, sites_selector, initial["options"])
+        check(district is not None, f"{sites_selector}: district change did not repopulate options")
+        if district:
+            changed = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+            check(changed["options"] == changed["rows"], f"{sites_selector}: option/row mismatch after district change")
+
+    component.locator('[data-multiselect-action="all"]').click()
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => { const s = document.querySelector(selector); return s && [...s.options].filter(o => !o.disabled).every(o => o.selected); }", sites_selector)
+    all_state = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(len(all_state["selected"]) == all_state["options"], f"{sites_selector}: Visi did not select every option")
+
+    component.locator('[data-multiselect-action="clear"]').click()
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => document.querySelector(selector)?.selectedOptions.length === 0", sites_selector)
+    clear_state = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(not clear_state["selected"] and not clear_state["checked"], f"{sites_selector}: Valyti did not clear selection")
+
+    return {
+        "initial": initial,
+        "toggled_chart_and_table": toggled,
+        "district": district,
+        "all_selected": len(all_state["selected"]),
+        "cleared_selected": len(clear_state["selected"]),
+    }
+
+
+with sync_playwright() as playwright:
+    browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+
+    for viewport_name, viewport in (("desktop", {"width": 1440, "height": 900}), ("mobile", {"width": 390, "height": 844})):
+        context = browser.new_context(viewport=viewport, ignore_https_errors=True)
+        if viewport_name == "mobile":
+            context.pages[0].close() if context.pages else None
+
+        oro, oro_errors = open_page(context, "/pages/oro.html#laboratoriniai")
+        oro_state = {
+            "selected": oro.locator("#tab-laboratory-air").get_attribute("aria-selected"),
+            "panel_visible": oro.locator("#panel-laboratory-air").is_visible(),
+            "errors": oro_errors,
+        }
+        check(oro_state["selected"] == "true" and oro_state["panel_visible"], f"oro deep link failed at {viewport_name}")
+        check(not oro_errors, f"oro deep link errors at {viewport_name}: {oro_errors}")
+        oro.evaluate("location.hash = '#nezinomas'")
+        oro.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        check(oro.locator("#tab-automatic-air").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"oro unknown hash did not restore default at {viewport_name}")
+        oro.evaluate("location.hash = '#laboratoriniai'")
+        oro.wait_for_timeout(120)
+        check(oro.locator("#tab-laboratory-air").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"oro hashchange failed at {viewport_name}")
+        results["deep_links"][f"oro_{viewport_name}"] = oro_state
+        oro.close()
+
+        wildlife, wildlife_errors = open_page(context, "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html#pauksciai")
+        bird_box = wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").bounding_box()
+        wildlife_state = {
+            "selected": wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").get_attribute("aria-selected"),
+            "visible": wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").is_visible(),
+            "in_viewport": bool(bird_box and bird_box["y"] < viewport["height"] and bird_box["y"] + bird_box["height"] > 0),
+            "errors": wildlife_errors,
+        }
+        check(wildlife_state["selected"] == "true" and wildlife_state["visible"] and wildlife_state["in_viewport"], f"wildlife deep link failed at {viewport_name}")
+        check(not wildlife_errors, f"wildlife deep link errors at {viewport_name}: {wildlife_errors}")
+        wildlife.evaluate("location.hash = '#nezinomas'")
+        wildlife.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        check(wildlife.locator("#augalija").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"wildlife unknown hash did not restore first tab at {viewport_name}")
+        wildlife.evaluate("location.hash = '#pauksciai'")
+        wildlife.wait_for_timeout(120)
+        check(wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"wildlife hashchange failed at {viewport_name}")
+        results["deep_links"][f"wildlife_{viewport_name}"] = wildlife_state
+        wildlife.close()
+
+        for path in ("/pages/oro.html", "/pages/prenumerata.html"):
+            nav_page, nav_errors = open_page(context, path, wait_ms=120)
+            nav = nav_page.evaluate(
+                """() => {
+                  const details = [...document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav details')].find(item => item.querySelector(':scope > summary')?.textContent.includes('Monitoringas'));
+                  return [...details.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul > li > a')].map(link => ({ text: link.textContent.trim(), href: link.getAttribute('href') }));
+                }"""
+            )
+            check(len(nav) == 6, f"{path}: expected 6 monitoring links, found {len(nav)} at {viewport_name}")
+            check([item["text"] for item in nav] == EXPECTED_NAV, f"{path}: monitoring link texts/order differ at {viewport_name}: {nav}")
+            check(all("#" not in item["href"] for item in nav), f"{path}: tab-switch hash link remains at {viewport_name}")
+            check(not nav_errors, f"{path}: navigation page errors at {viewport_name}: {nav_errors}")
+            results["navigation"][f"{Path(path).stem}_{viewport_name}"] = nav
+            nav_page.close()
+        context.close()
+
+    desktop = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900}, ignore_https_errors=True)
+    water, water_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/vanduo.html")
+    results["multiselects"]["water"] = exercise_multiselect(water, "#water-sites", "[data-role='status']", "[data-chart='main']", "[data-role='table']", "#water-district")
+    check(not water_errors, f"water errors: {water_errors}")
+    screenshot_dir = Path(tempfile.gettempdir())
+    water_desktop_shot = screenshot_dir / "kms-batch-a-water-desktop.png"
+    water.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").screenshot(path=str(water_desktop_shot))
+    results["screenshots"]["water_desktop"] = str(water_desktop_shot)
+    water.close()
+
+    oro, oro_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/oro.html#laboratoriniai")
+    for selector in ("#air-sites", "#lab-sites"):
+        state = component_state(oro, selector)
+        check(state["options"] == state["rows"] and state["visible"], f"{selector}: oro list did not mirror native options")
+        check(sorted(state["selected"]) == sorted(state["checked"]), f"{selector}: oro native/custom state differs")
+        results["multiselects"][selector] = state
+    lab_component = oro.locator("#lab-sites + .multiselect")
+    if lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').count():
+        lab_value = lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first.get_attribute("value")
+        lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first.uncheck()
+        check(lab_value not in selected_values(oro, "#lab-sites"), "oro laboratory checkbox did not sync native select")
+    check(not oro_errors, f"oro multiselect errors: {oro_errors}")
+    oro.close()
+
+    greenery, greenery_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/zeldynai.html")
+    results["multiselects"]["greenery"] = exercise_multiselect(greenery, "#greenery-sites", "#greenery-status", "#greenery-chart", "#greenery-table", "#greenery-district")
+    check(not greenery_errors, f"greenery errors: {greenery_errors}")
+    greenery.close()
+    desktop.close()
+
+    mobile_visual = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844}, ignore_https_errors=True)
+    water_mobile, mobile_errors = open_page(mobile_visual, "/pages/vanduo.html")
+    water_mobile.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
+    water_mobile_shot = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "kms-batch-a-water-mobile.png"
+    water_mobile.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").screenshot(path=str(water_mobile_shot))
+    results["screenshots"]["water_mobile"] = str(water_mobile_shot)
+    check(not mobile_errors, f"water mobile errors: {mobile_errors}")
+    water_mobile.close()
+    mobile_visual.close()
+
+    for viewport_name, viewport in (("desktop", {"width": 1440, "height": 900}), ("mobile", {"width": 390, "height": 844})):
+        context = browser.new_context(viewport=viewport, ignore_https_errors=True)
+        page_results = {}
+        for path in PUBLIC_PAGES:
+            page, errors = open_page(context, path, wait_ms=350)
+            width = page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
+            page_results[path] = {"scrollWidth": width, "errors": errors}
+            if viewport_name == "desktop":
+                check(not errors, f"{path}: desktop console/page errors: {errors}")
+            if viewport_name == "mobile":
+                check(width <= 396, f"{path}: mobile scrollWidth is {width}px")
+            page.close()
+        results["public_pages"][viewport_name] = page_results
+        context.close()
+
+    browser.close()
+
+results["failures"] = failures
+results["summary"] = {
+    "failure_count": len(failures),
+    "desktop_error_count": sum(len(item["errors"]) for item in results["public_pages"]["desktop"].values()),
+    "mobile_max_scroll_width": max(item["scrollWidth"] for item in results["public_pages"]["mobile"].values()),
+}
+print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+raise SystemExit(1 if failures else 0)

diff --git a/demo/js/ui/multiselect.js b/demo/js/ui/multiselect.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7df7ff6f0adc60728cbb1533b0a3fbb549208bca
--- /dev/null
+++ b/demo/js/ui/multiselect.js
@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+function optionLabel(option) {
+  return option.label || option.textContent || option.value;
+}
+
+function initMultiSelect(select) {
+  if (select.dataset.multiselectInitialized === "true") return;
+
+  select.dataset.multiselectInitialized = "true";
+  select.classList.add("multiselect-native");
+  select.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
+  select.inert = true;
+  select.tabIndex = -1;
+
+  const label = select.labels?.[0];
+  if (label && !label.id) label.id = `${select.id}-label`;
+
+  const multiselect = document.createElement("div");
+  multiselect.className = "multiselect";
+  multiselect.setAttribute("role", "group");
+  if (label?.id) multiselect.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", label.id);
+  if (select.getAttribute("aria-describedby")) multiselect.setAttribute("aria-describedby", select.getAttribute("aria-describedby"));
+  multiselect.innerHTML = `
+    <div class="multiselect__toolbar">
+      <span class="multiselect__count" aria-live="polite"></span>
+      <span class="multiselect__actions">
+        <button class="multiselect__action" type="button" data-multiselect-action="all">Visi</button>
+        <button class="multiselect__action" type="button" data-multiselect-action="clear">Valyti</button>
+      </span>
+    </div>
+    <div class="multiselect__list"></div>`;
+  select.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", multiselect);
+
+  const count = multiselect.querySelector(".multiselect__count");
+  const list = multiselect.querySelector(".multiselect__list");
+  const selectAll = multiselect.querySelector('[data-multiselect-action="all"]');
+  const clear = multiselect.querySelector('[data-multiselect-action="clear"]');
+  let selectedValues = new Set([...select.selectedOptions].map((option) => option.value));
+
+  function syncState() {
+    const options = [...select.options];
+    const selected = options.filter((option) => option.selected);
+    const checkboxes = [...list.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]')];
+
+    checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
+      const option = options.find((item) => item.value === checkbox.value);
+      if (!option) return;
+      checkbox.checked = option.selected;
+      checkbox.disabled = option.disabled;
+    });
+
+    selectedValues = new Set(selected.map((option) => option.value));
+    count.textContent = `${selected.length} iš ${options.length} pasirinkta`;
+    selectAll.disabled = options.length === 0 || options.every((option) => option.disabled || option.selected);
+    clear.disabled = selected.length === 0;
+  }
+
+  function dispatchChange() {
+    syncState();
+    select.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
+  }
+
+  function renderList() {
+    const options = [...select.options];
+    if (!options.some((option) => option.selected) && selectedValues.size) {
+      options.forEach((option) => { option.selected = selectedValues.has(option.value); });
+    }
+
+    list.replaceChildren();
+    if (!options.length) {
+      const empty = document.createElement("p");
+      empty.className = "multiselect__empty";
+      empty.textContent = "Pagal pasirinktus filtrus taškų nėra.";
+      list.append(empty);
+      syncState();
+      return;
+    }
+
+    options.forEach((option) => {
+      const row = document.createElement("label");
+      row.className = "multiselect__option";
+
+      const checkbox = document.createElement("input");
+      checkbox.type = "checkbox";
+      checkbox.value = option.value;
+      checkbox.checked = option.selected;
+      checkbox.disabled = option.disabled;
+      checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => {
+        option.selected = checkbox.checked;
+        dispatchChange();
+      });
+
+      const text = document.createElement("span");
+      text.className = "multiselect__option-text";
+      text.textContent = optionLabel(option);
+      row.append(checkbox, text);
+      list.append(row);
+    });
+
+    syncState();
+  }
+
+  selectAll.addEventListener("click", () => {
+    [...select.options].forEach((option) => { option.selected = !option.disabled; });
+    dispatchChange();
+  });
+  clear.addEventListener("click", () => {
+    [...select.options].forEach((option) => { option.selected = false; });
+    dispatchChange();
+  });
+  select.addEventListener("change", syncState);
+
+  const observer = new MutationObserver(renderList);
+  observer.observe(select, { attributes: true, childList: true, subtree: true });
+  renderList();
+}
+
+export function initMultiSelects(root = document) {
+  root.querySelectorAll("select.select-field[multiple]").forEach(initMultiSelect);
+}

+import io
+import json
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
+
+sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", line_buffering=True)
+
+BASE = "http://localhost:8000"
+PUBLIC_PAGES = [
+    "/index.html",
+    "/pages/ataskaitos.html",
+    "/pages/bendra-info.html",
+    "/pages/dirvezemis.html",
+    "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html",
+    "/pages/oro.html",
+    "/pages/prenumerata.html",
+    "/pages/privatumo-politika.html",
+    "/pages/slapuku-politika.html",
+    "/pages/truksmas.html",
+    "/pages/vadovas.html",
+    "/pages/vanduo.html",
+    "/pages/zeldynai.html",
+    "/pages/zemelapis.html",
+]
+EXPECTED_NAV = [
+    "Automatinių stotelių duomenys",
+    "Aplinkos triukšmo monitoringas",
+    "Dirvožemio monitoringas",
+    "Paviršinio vandens monitoringas",
+    "Gyvosios gamtos monitoringas",
+    "Želdynų ir želdinių monitoringas",
+]
+
+failures = []
+results = {
+    "deep_links": {},
+    "navigation": {},
+    "multiselects": {},
+    "public_pages": {},
+    "screenshots": {},
+}
+
+
+def check(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        failures.append(message)
+
+
+def open_page(context, path, wait_ms=650):
+    page = context.new_page()
+    errors = []
+    page.on("console", lambda message: errors.append(f"console: {message.text}") if message.type == "error" else None)
+    page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append(f"pageerror: {error}"))
+    page.goto(f"{BASE}{path}", wait_until="load")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(wait_ms)
+    return page, errors
+
+
+def selected_values(page, selector):
+    return page.locator(selector).evaluate("select => [...select.selectedOptions].map(option => option.value)")
+
+
+def component_state(page, selector):
+    return page.locator(selector).evaluate(
+        """select => {
+            const component = select.nextElementSibling;
+            return {
+              options: select.options.length,
+              selected: [...select.selectedOptions].map(option => option.value),
+              rows: component?.querySelectorAll('.multiselect__option').length || 0,
+              checked: [...(component?.querySelectorAll('.multiselect__option input:checked') || [])].map(input => input.value),
+              count: component?.querySelector('.multiselect__count')?.textContent || '',
+              visible: Boolean(component && component.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0),
+              nativeWidth: select.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+              inert: select.inert,
+            };
+        }"""
+    )
+
+
+def choose_reducing_district(page, district_selector, sites_selector, initial_count):
+    values = page.locator(district_selector).locator("option").evaluate_all("options => options.map(option => option.value).filter(value => value !== 'all')")
+    for value in values:
+        page.select_option(district_selector, value)
+        page.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        count = page.locator(sites_selector).evaluate("select => select.options.length")
+        if count != initial_count:
+            return {"value": value, "count": count}
+    return None
+
+
+def exercise_multiselect(page, sites_selector, status_selector, chart_selector, table_selector, district_selector=None):
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => document.querySelector(selector)?.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('multiselect')", arg=sites_selector)
+    initial = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(initial["visible"], f"{sites_selector}: custom list is not visible")
+    check(initial["options"] == initial["rows"], f"{sites_selector}: option/row count mismatch ({initial['options']} / {initial['rows']})")
+    check(sorted(initial["selected"]) == sorted(initial["checked"]), f"{sites_selector}: initial native/custom state differs")
+    check(initial["nativeWidth"] <= 1.1 and initial["inert"], f"{sites_selector}: native select is not visually hidden and inert")
+
+    component = page.locator(f"{sites_selector} + .multiselect")
+    first_checked = component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first
+    before = {
+        "status": page.locator(status_selector).inner_text(),
+        "table_rows": page.locator(f"{table_selector} tbody tr").count(),
+        "chart_sets": page.locator(chart_selector).evaluate("canvas => canvas._kmsChart?.data.datasets.length ?? -1"),
+    }
+    toggled = False
+    if first_checked.count():
+        value = first_checked.get_attribute("value")
+        first_checked.uncheck()
+        page.wait_for_function("([selector, old]) => document.querySelector(selector)?.textContent !== old", arg=[status_selector, before["status"]])
+        after = {
+            "status": page.locator(status_selector).inner_text(),
+            "table_rows": page.locator(f"{table_selector} tbody tr").count(),
+            "chart_sets": page.locator(chart_selector).evaluate("canvas => canvas._kmsChart?.data.datasets.length ?? -1"),
+        }
+        native_after = selected_values(page, sites_selector)
+        check(value not in native_after, f"{sites_selector}: uncheck did not update native select")
+        check(after["table_rows"] != before["table_rows"], f"{sites_selector}: table did not update after uncheck")
+        check(after["chart_sets"] != before["chart_sets"], f"{sites_selector}: chart did not update after uncheck")
+        component.locator(f'.multiselect__option input[value="{value}"]').check()
+        page.wait_for_function("([selector, old]) => document.querySelector(selector)?.textContent === old", arg=[status_selector, before["status"]])
+        toggled = True
+
+    district = None
+    if district_selector:
+        district = choose_reducing_district(page, district_selector, sites_selector, initial["options"])
+        check(district is not None, f"{sites_selector}: district change did not repopulate options")
+        if district:
+            changed = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+            check(changed["options"] == changed["rows"], f"{sites_selector}: option/row mismatch after district change")
+
+    component.locator('[data-multiselect-action="all"]').click()
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => { const s = document.querySelector(selector); return s && [...s.options].filter(o => !o.disabled).every(o => o.selected); }", arg=sites_selector)
+    all_state = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(len(all_state["selected"]) == all_state["options"], f"{sites_selector}: Visi did not select every option")
+
+    component.locator('[data-multiselect-action="clear"]').click()
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => document.querySelector(selector)?.selectedOptions.length === 0", arg=sites_selector)
+    clear_state = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(not clear_state["selected"] and not clear_state["checked"], f"{sites_selector}: Valyti did not clear selection")
+
+    return {
+        "initial": initial,
+        "toggled_chart_and_table": toggled,
+        "district": district,
+        "all_selected": len(all_state["selected"]),
+        "cleared_selected": len(clear_state["selected"]),
+    }
+
+
+with sync_playwright() as playwright:
+    browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+
+    for viewport_name, viewport in (("desktop", {"width": 1440, "height": 900}), ("mobile", {"width": 390, "height": 844})):
+        context = browser.new_context(viewport=viewport, ignore_https_errors=True)
+        if viewport_name == "mobile":
+            context.pages[0].close() if context.pages else None
+
+        oro, oro_errors = open_page(context, "/pages/oro.html#laboratoriniai")
+        oro_state = {
+            "selected": oro.locator("#tab-laboratory-air").get_attribute("aria-selected"),
+            "panel_visible": oro.locator("#panel-laboratory-air").is_visible(),
+            "errors": oro_errors,
+        }
+        check(oro_state["selected"] == "true" and oro_state["panel_visible"], f"oro deep link failed at {viewport_name}")
+        check(not oro_errors, f"oro deep link errors at {viewport_name}: {oro_errors}")
+        oro.evaluate("location.hash = '#nezinomas'")
+        oro.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        check(oro.locator("#tab-automatic-air").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"oro unknown hash did not restore default at {viewport_name}")
+        oro.evaluate("location.hash = '#laboratoriniai'")
+        oro.wait_for_timeout(120)
+        check(oro.locator("#tab-laboratory-air").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"oro hashchange failed at {viewport_name}")
+        results["deep_links"][f"oro_{viewport_name}"] = oro_state
+        oro.close()
+
+        wildlife, wildlife_errors = open_page(context, "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html#pauksciai")
+        bird_box = wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").bounding_box()
+        wildlife_state = {
+            "selected": wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").get_attribute("aria-selected"),
+            "visible": wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").is_visible(),
+            "in_viewport": bool(bird_box and bird_box["y"] < viewport["height"] and bird_box["y"] + bird_box["height"] > 0),
+            "errors": wildlife_errors,
+        }
+        check(wildlife_state["selected"] == "true" and wildlife_state["visible"] and wildlife_state["in_viewport"], f"wildlife deep link failed at {viewport_name}")
+        check(not wildlife_errors, f"wildlife deep link errors at {viewport_name}: {wildlife_errors}")
+        wildlife.evaluate("location.hash = '#nezinomas'")
+        wildlife.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        check(wildlife.locator("#augalija").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"wildlife unknown hash did not restore first tab at {viewport_name}")
+        wildlife.evaluate("location.hash = '#pauksciai'")
+        wildlife.wait_for_timeout(120)
+        check(wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"wildlife hashchange failed at {viewport_name}")
+        results["deep_links"][f"wildlife_{viewport_name}"] = wildlife_state
+        wildlife.close()
+
+        for path in ("/pages/oro.html", "/pages/prenumerata.html"):
+            nav_page, nav_errors = open_page(context, path, wait_ms=120)
+            nav = nav_page.evaluate(
+                """() => {
+                  const details = [...document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav details')].find(item => item.querySelector(':scope > summary')?.textContent.includes('Monitoringas'));
+                  return [...details.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul > li > a')].map(link => ({ text: link.textContent.trim(), href: link.getAttribute('href') }));
+                }"""
+            )
+            check(len(nav) == 6, f"{path}: expected 6 monitoring links, found {len(nav)} at {viewport_name}")
+            check([item["text"] for item in nav] == EXPECTED_NAV, f"{path}: monitoring link texts/order differ at {viewport_name}: {nav}")
+            check(all("#" not in item["href"] for item in nav), f"{path}: tab-switch hash link remains at {viewport_name}")
+            check(not nav_errors, f"{path}: navigation page errors at {viewport_name}: {nav_errors}")
+            results["navigation"][f"{Path(path).stem}_{viewport_name}"] = nav
+            nav_page.close()
+        context.close()
+
+    desktop = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900}, ignore_https_errors=True)
+    water, water_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/vanduo.html")
+    results["multiselects"]["water"] = exercise_multiselect(water, "#water-sites", "[data-role='status']", "[data-chart='main']", "[data-role='table']", "#water-district")
+    check(not water_errors, f"water errors: {water_errors}")
+    screenshot_dir = Path(tempfile.gettempdir())
+    water_desktop_shot = screenshot_dir / "kms-batch-a-water-desktop.png"
+    water.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").screenshot(path=str(water_desktop_shot))
+    results["screenshots"]["water_desktop"] = str(water_desktop_shot)
+    water.close()
+
+    oro, oro_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/oro.html#laboratoriniai")
+    for selector in ("#air-sites", "#lab-sites"):
+        state = component_state(oro, selector)
+        check(state["options"] == state["rows"] and state["visible"], f"{selector}: oro list did not mirror native options")
+        check(sorted(state["selected"]) == sorted(state["checked"]), f"{selector}: oro native/custom state differs")
+        results["multiselects"][selector] = state
+    lab_component = oro.locator("#lab-sites + .multiselect")
+    if lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').count():
+        lab_value = lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first.get_attribute("value")
+        lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first.uncheck()
+        check(lab_value not in selected_values(oro, "#lab-sites"), "oro laboratory checkbox did not sync native select")
+    check(not oro_errors, f"oro multiselect errors: {oro_errors}")
+    oro.close()
+
+    greenery, greenery_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/zeldynai.html")
+    results["multiselects"]["greenery"] = exercise_multiselect(greenery, "#greenery-sites", "#greenery-status", "#greenery-chart", "#greenery-table", "#greenery-district")
+    check(not greenery_errors, f"greenery errors: {greenery_errors}")
+    greenery.close()
+    desktop.close()
+
+    mobile_visual = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844}, ignore_https_errors=True)
+    water_mobile, mobile_errors = open_page(mobile_visual, "/pages/vanduo.html")
+    water_mobile.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
+    water_mobile_shot = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "kms-batch-a-water-mobile.png"
+    water_mobile.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").screenshot(path=str(water_mobile_shot))
+    results["screenshots"]["water_mobile"] = str(water_mobile_shot)
+    check(not mobile_errors, f"water mobile errors: {mobile_errors}")
+    water_mobile.close()
+    mobile_visual.close()
+
+    for viewport_name, viewport in (("desktop", {"width": 1440, "height": 900}), ("mobile", {"width": 390, "height": 844})):
+        context = browser.new_context(viewport=viewport, ignore_https_errors=True)
+        page_results = {}
+        for path in PUBLIC_PAGES:
+            page, errors = open_page(context, path, wait_ms=350)
+            width = page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
+            page_results[path] = {"scrollWidth": width, "errors": errors}
+            if viewport_name == "desktop":
+                check(not errors, f"{path}: desktop console/page errors: {errors}")
+            if viewport_name == "mobile":
+                check(width <= 396, f"{path}: mobile scrollWidth is {width}px")
+            page.close()
+        results["public_pages"][viewport_name] = page_results
+        context.close()
+
+    browser.close()
+
+results["failures"] = failures
+results["summary"] = {
+    "failure_count": len(failures),
+    "desktop_error_count": sum(len(item["errors"]) for item in results["public_pages"]["desktop"].values()),
+    "mobile_max_scroll_width": max(item["scrollWidth"] for item in results["public_pages"]["mobile"].values()),
+}
+print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+raise SystemExit(1 if failures else 0)

diff --git a/demo/js/ui/multiselect.js b/demo/js/ui/multiselect.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7df7ff6f0adc60728cbb1533b0a3fbb549208bca
--- /dev/null
+++ b/demo/js/ui/multiselect.js
@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+function optionLabel(option) {
+  return option.label || option.textContent || option.value;
+}
+
+function initMultiSelect(select) {
+  if (select.dataset.multiselectInitialized === "true") return;
+
+  select.dataset.multiselectInitialized = "true";
+  select.classList.add("multiselect-native");
+  select.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
+  select.inert = true;
+  select.tabIndex = -1;
+
+  const label = select.labels?.[0];
+  if (label && !label.id) label.id = `${select.id}-label`;
+
+  const multiselect = document.createElement("div");
+  multiselect.className = "multiselect";
+  multiselect.setAttribute("role", "group");
+  if (label?.id) multiselect.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", label.id);
+  if (select.getAttribute("aria-describedby")) multiselect.setAttribute("aria-describedby", select.getAttribute("aria-describedby"));
+  multiselect.innerHTML = `
+    <div class="multiselect__toolbar">
+      <span class="multiselect__count" aria-live="polite"></span>
+      <span class="multiselect__actions">
+        <button class="multiselect__action" type="button" data-multiselect-action="all">Visi</button>
+        <button class="multiselect__action" type="button" data-multiselect-action="clear">Valyti</button>
+      </span>
+    </div>
+    <div class="multiselect__list"></div>`;
+  select.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", multiselect);
+
+  const count = multiselect.querySelector(".multiselect__count");
+  const list = multiselect.querySelector(".multiselect__list");
+  const selectAll = multiselect.querySelector('[data-multiselect-action="all"]');
+  const clear = multiselect.querySelector('[data-multiselect-action="clear"]');
+  let selectedValues = new Set([...select.selectedOptions].map((option) => option.value));
+
+  function syncState() {
+    const options = [...select.options];
+    const selected = options.filter((option) => option.selected);
+    const checkboxes = [...list.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]')];
+
+    checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
+      const option = options.find((item) => item.value === checkbox.value);
+      if (!option) return;
+      checkbox.checked = option.selected;
+      checkbox.disabled = option.disabled;
+    });
+
+    selectedValues = new Set(selected.map((option) => option.value));
+    count.textContent = `${selected.length} iš ${options.length} pasirinkta`;
+    selectAll.disabled = options.length === 0 || options.every((option) => option.disabled || option.selected);
+    clear.disabled = selected.length === 0;
+  }
+
+  function dispatchChange() {
+    syncState();
+    select.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
+  }
+
+  function renderList() {
+    const options = [...select.options];
+    if (!options.some((option) => option.selected) && selectedValues.size) {
+      options.forEach((option) => { option.selected = selectedValues.has(option.value); });
+    }
+
+    list.replaceChildren();
+    if (!options.length) {
+      const empty = document.createElement("p");
+      empty.className = "multiselect__empty";
+      empty.textContent = "Pagal pasirinktus filtrus taškų nėra.";
+      list.append(empty);
+      syncState();
+      return;
+    }
+
+    options.forEach((option) => {
+      const row = document.createElement("label");
+      row.className = "multiselect__option";
+
+      const checkbox = document.createElement("input");
+      checkbox.type = "checkbox";
+      checkbox.value = option.value;
+      checkbox.checked = option.selected;
+      checkbox.disabled = option.disabled;
+      checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => {
+        option.selected = checkbox.checked;
+        dispatchChange();
+      });
+
+      const text = document.createElement("span");
+      text.className = "multiselect__option-text";
+      text.textContent = optionLabel(option);
+      row.append(checkbox, text);
+      list.append(row);
+    });
+
+    syncState();
+  }
+
+  selectAll.addEventListener("click", () => {
+    [...select.options].forEach((option) => { option.selected = !option.disabled; });
+    dispatchChange();
+  });
+  clear.addEventListener("click", () => {
+    [...select.options].forEach((option) => { option.selected = false; });
+    dispatchChange();
+  });
+  select.addEventListener("change", syncState);
+
+  const observer = new MutationObserver(renderList);
+  observer.observe(select, { attributes: true, childList: true, subtree: true });
+  renderList();
+}
+
+export function initMultiSelects(root = document) {
+  root.querySelectorAll("select.select-field[multiple]").forEach(initMultiSelect);
+}

diff --git a/.tmp_batch_a_verify.py b/.tmp_batch_a_verify.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7d53ca5f74dd4f3595e0ed315ec6804165381937
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.tmp_batch_a_verify.py
@@ -0,0 +1,279 @@
+import io
+import json
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
+
+sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", line_buffering=True)
+
+BASE = "http://localhost:8000"
+PUBLIC_PAGES = [
+    "/index.html",
+    "/pages/ataskaitos.html",
+    "/pages/bendra-info.html",
+    "/pages/dirvezemis.html",
+    "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html",
+    "/pages/oro.html",
+    "/pages/prenumerata.html",
+    "/pages/privatumo-politika.html",
+    "/pages/slapuku-politika.html",
+    "/pages/truksmas.html",
+    "/pages/vadovas.html",
+    "/pages/vanduo.html",
+    "/pages/zeldynai.html",
+    "/pages/zemelapis.html",
+]
+EXPECTED_NAV = [
+    "Automatinių stotelių duomenys",
+    "Aplinkos triukšmo monitoringas",
+    "Dirvožemio monitoringas",
+    "Paviršinio vandens monitoringas",
+    "Gyvosios gamtos monitoringas",
+    "Želdynų ir želdinių monitoringas",
+]
+
+failures = []
+results = {
+    "deep_links": {},
+    "navigation": {},
+    "multiselects": {},
+    "public_pages": {},
+    "screenshots": {},
+}
+
+
+def check(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        failures.append(message)
+
+
+def open_page(context, path, wait_ms=650):
+    page = context.new_page()
+    errors = []
+    page.on("console", lambda message: errors.append(f"console: {message.text}") if message.type == "error" else None)
+    page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append(f"pageerror: {error}"))
+    page.goto(f"{BASE}{path}", wait_until="load")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(wait_ms)
+    return page, errors
+
+
+def selected_values(page, selector):
+    return page.locator(selector).evaluate("select => [...select.selectedOptions].map(option => option.value)")
+
+
+def component_state(page, selector):
+    return page.locator(selector).evaluate(
+        """select => {
+            const component = select.nextElementSibling;
+            return {
+              options: select.options.length,
+              selected: [...select.selectedOptions].map(option => option.value),
+              rows: component?.querySelectorAll('.multiselect__option').length || 0,
+              checked: [...(component?.querySelectorAll('.multiselect__option input:checked') || [])].map(input => input.value),
+              count: component?.querySelector('.multiselect__count')?.textContent || '',
+              visible: Boolean(component && component.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0),
+              nativeWidth: select.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+              inert: select.inert,
+            };
+        }"""
+    )
+
+
+def choose_reducing_district(page, district_selector, sites_selector, initial_count):
+    values = page.locator(district_selector).locator("option").evaluate_all("options => options.map(option => option.value).filter(value => value !== 'all')")
+    for value in values:
+        page.select_option(district_selector, value)
+        page.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        count = page.locator(sites_selector).evaluate("select => select.options.length")
+        if count != initial_count:
+            return {"value": value, "count": count}
+    return None
+
+
+def exercise_multiselect(page, sites_selector, status_selector, chart_selector, table_selector, district_selector=None):
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => document.querySelector(selector)?.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('multiselect')", arg=sites_selector)
+    initial = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(initial["visible"], f"{sites_selector}: custom list is not visible")
+    check(initial["options"] == initial["rows"], f"{sites_selector}: option/row count mismatch ({initial['options']} / {initial['rows']})")
+    check(sorted(initial["selected"]) == sorted(initial["checked"]), f"{sites_selector}: initial native/custom state differs")
+    check(initial["nativeWidth"] <= 1.1 and initial["inert"], f"{sites_selector}: native select is not visually hidden and inert")
+
+    component = page.locator(f"{sites_selector} + .multiselect")
+    first_checked = component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first
+    before = {
+        "status": page.locator(status_selector).inner_text(),
+        "table_rows": page.locator(f"{table_selector} tbody tr").count(),
+        "chart_sets": page.locator(chart_selector).evaluate("canvas => canvas._kmsChart?.data.datasets.length ?? -1"),
+    }
+    toggled = False
+    if first_checked.count():
+        value = first_checked.get_attribute("value")
+        first_checked.uncheck()
+        page.wait_for_function("([selector, old]) => document.querySelector(selector)?.textContent !== old", arg=[status_selector, before["status"]])
+        after = {
+            "status": page.locator(status_selector).inner_text(),
+            "table_rows": page.locator(f"{table_selector} tbody tr").count(),
+            "chart_sets": page.locator(chart_selector).evaluate("canvas => canvas._kmsChart?.data.datasets.length ?? -1"),
+        }
+        native_after = selected_values(page, sites_selector)
+        check(value not in native_after, f"{sites_selector}: uncheck did not update native select")
+        check(after["table_rows"] != before["table_rows"], f"{sites_selector}: table did not update after uncheck")
+        check(after["chart_sets"] != before["chart_sets"], f"{sites_selector}: chart did not update after uncheck")
+        component.locator(f'.multiselect__option input[value="{value}"]').check()
+        page.wait_for_function("([selector, old]) => document.querySelector(selector)?.textContent === old", arg=[status_selector, before["status"]])
+        toggled = True
+
+    district = None
+    if district_selector:
+        district = choose_reducing_district(page, district_selector, sites_selector, initial["options"])
+        check(district is not None, f"{sites_selector}: district change did not repopulate options")
+        if district:
+            changed = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+            check(changed["options"] == changed["rows"], f"{sites_selector}: option/row mismatch after district change")
+
+    component.locator('[data-multiselect-action="all"]').click()
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => { const s = document.querySelector(selector); return s && [...s.options].filter(o => !o.disabled).every(o => o.selected); }", arg=sites_selector)
+    all_state = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(len(all_state["selected"]) == all_state["options"], f"{sites_selector}: Visi did not select every option")
+
+    component.locator('[data-multiselect-action="clear"]').click()
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => document.querySelector(selector)?.selectedOptions.length === 0", arg=sites_selector)
+    clear_state = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(not clear_state["selected"] and not clear_state["checked"], f"{sites_selector}: Valyti did not clear selection")
+
+    return {
+        "initial": initial,
+        "toggled_chart_and_table": toggled,
+        "district": district,
+        "all_selected": len(all_state["selected"]),
+        "cleared_selected": len(clear_state["selected"]),
+    }
+
+
+with sync_playwright() as playwright:
+    browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+
+    for viewport_name, viewport in (("desktop", {"width": 1440, "height": 900}), ("mobile", {"width": 390, "height": 844})):
+        context = browser.new_context(viewport=viewport, ignore_https_errors=True)
+        if viewport_name == "mobile":
+            context.pages[0].close() if context.pages else None
+
+        oro, oro_errors = open_page(context, "/pages/oro.html#laboratoriniai")
+        oro_state = {
+            "selected": oro.locator("#tab-laboratory-air").get_attribute("aria-selected"),
+            "panel_visible": oro.locator("#panel-laboratory-air").is_visible(),
+            "errors": oro_errors,
+        }
+        check(oro_state["selected"] == "true" and oro_state["panel_visible"], f"oro deep link failed at {viewport_name}")
+        check(not oro_errors, f"oro deep link errors at {viewport_name}: {oro_errors}")
+        oro.evaluate("location.hash = '#nezinomas'")
+        oro.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        check(oro.locator("#tab-automatic-air").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"oro unknown hash did not restore default at {viewport_name}")
+        oro.evaluate("location.hash = '#laboratoriniai'")
+        oro.wait_for_timeout(120)
+        check(oro.locator("#tab-laboratory-air").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"oro hashchange failed at {viewport_name}")
+        results["deep_links"][f"oro_{viewport_name}"] = oro_state
+        oro.close()
+
+        wildlife, wildlife_errors = open_page(context, "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html#pauksciai")
+        bird_box = wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").bounding_box()
+        wildlife_state = {
+            "selected": wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").get_attribute("aria-selected"),
+            "visible": wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").is_visible(),
+            "in_viewport": bool(bird_box and bird_box["y"] < viewport["height"] and bird_box["y"] + bird_box["height"] > 0),
+            "errors": wildlife_errors,
+        }
+        check(wildlife_state["selected"] == "true" and wildlife_state["visible"] and wildlife_state["in_viewport"], f"wildlife deep link failed at {viewport_name}")
+        check(not wildlife_errors, f"wildlife deep link errors at {viewport_name}: {wildlife_errors}")
+        wildlife.evaluate("location.hash = '#nezinomas'")
+        wildlife.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        check(wildlife.locator("#augalija").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"wildlife unknown hash did not restore first tab at {viewport_name}")
+        wildlife.evaluate("location.hash = '#pauksciai'")
+        wildlife.wait_for_timeout(120)
+        check(wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"wildlife hashchange failed at {viewport_name}")
+        results["deep_links"][f"wildlife_{viewport_name}"] = wildlife_state
+        wildlife.close()
+
+        for path in ("/pages/oro.html", "/pages/prenumerata.html"):
+            nav_page, nav_errors = open_page(context, path, wait_ms=120)
+            nav = nav_page.evaluate(
+                """() => {
+                  const details = [...document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav details')].find(item => item.querySelector(':scope > summary')?.textContent.includes('Monitoringas'));
+                  return [...details.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul > li > a')].map(link => ({ text: link.textContent.trim(), href: link.getAttribute('href') }));
+                }"""
+            )
+            check(len(nav) == 6, f"{path}: expected 6 monitoring links, found {len(nav)} at {viewport_name}")
+            check([item["text"] for item in nav] == EXPECTED_NAV, f"{path}: monitoring link texts/order differ at {viewport_name}: {nav}")
+            check(all("#" not in item["href"] for item in nav), f"{path}: tab-switch hash link remains at {viewport_name}")
+            check(not nav_errors, f"{path}: navigation page errors at {viewport_name}: {nav_errors}")
+            results["navigation"][f"{Path(path).stem}_{viewport_name}"] = nav
+            nav_page.close()
+        context.close()
+
+    desktop = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900}, ignore_https_errors=True)
+    water, water_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/vanduo.html")
+    results["multiselects"]["water"] = exercise_multiselect(water, "#water-sites", "[data-role='status']", "[data-chart='main']", "[data-role='table']", "#water-district")
+    check(not water_errors, f"water errors: {water_errors}")
+    screenshot_dir = Path(tempfile.gettempdir())
+    water_desktop_shot = screenshot_dir / "kms-batch-a-water-desktop.png"
+    water.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").screenshot(path=str(water_desktop_shot))
+    results["screenshots"]["water_desktop"] = str(water_desktop_shot)
+    water.close()
+
+    oro, oro_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/oro.html#laboratoriniai")
+    for selector in ("#air-sites", "#lab-sites"):
+        state = component_state(oro, selector)
+        check(state["options"] == state["rows"] and state["visible"], f"{selector}: oro list did not mirror native options")
+        check(sorted(state["selected"]) == sorted(state["checked"]), f"{selector}: oro native/custom state differs")
+        results["multiselects"][selector] = state
+    lab_component = oro.locator("#lab-sites + .multiselect")
+    if lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').count():
+        lab_value = lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first.get_attribute("value")
+        lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first.uncheck()
+        check(lab_value not in selected_values(oro, "#lab-sites"), "oro laboratory checkbox did not sync native select")
+    check(not oro_errors, f"oro multiselect errors: {oro_errors}")
+    oro.close()
+
+    greenery, greenery_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/zeldynai.html")
+    results["multiselects"]["greenery"] = exercise_multiselect(greenery, "#greenery-sites", "#greenery-status", "#greenery-chart", "#greenery-table", "#greenery-district")
+    check(not greenery_errors, f"greenery errors: {greenery_errors}")
+    greenery.close()
+    desktop.close()
+
+    mobile_visual = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844}, ignore_https_errors=True)
+    water_mobile, mobile_errors = open_page(mobile_visual, "/pages/vanduo.html")
+    water_mobile.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
+    water_mobile_shot = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "kms-batch-a-water-mobile.png"
+    water_mobile.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").screenshot(path=str(water_mobile_shot))
+    results["screenshots"]["water_mobile"] = str(water_mobile_shot)
+    check(not mobile_errors, f"water mobile errors: {mobile_errors}")
+    water_mobile.close()
+    mobile_visual.close()
+
+    for viewport_name, viewport in (("desktop", {"width": 1440, "height": 900}), ("mobile", {"width": 390, "height": 844})):
+        context = browser.new_context(viewport=viewport, ignore_https_errors=True)
+        page_results = {}
+        for path in PUBLIC_PAGES:
+            page, errors = open_page(context, path, wait_ms=350)
+            width = page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
+            page_results[path] = {"scrollWidth": width, "errors": errors}
+            if viewport_name == "desktop":
+                check(not errors, f"{path}: desktop console/page errors: {errors}")
+            if viewport_name == "mobile":
+                check(width <= 396, f"{path}: mobile scrollWidth is {width}px")
+            page.close()
+        results["public_pages"][viewport_name] = page_results
+        context.close()
+
+    browser.close()
+
+results["failures"] = failures
+results["summary"] = {
+    "failure_count": len(failures),
+    "desktop_error_count": sum(len(item["errors"]) for item in results["public_pages"]["desktop"].values()),
+    "mobile_max_scroll_width": max(item["scrollWidth"] for item in results["public_pages"]["mobile"].values()),
+}
+print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+raise SystemExit(1 if failures else 0)

diff --git a/demo/js/ui/multiselect.js b/demo/js/ui/multiselect.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..7df7ff6f0adc60728cbb1533b0a3fbb549208bca
--- /dev/null
+++ b/demo/js/ui/multiselect.js
@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+function optionLabel(option) {
+  return option.label || option.textContent || option.value;
+}
+
+function initMultiSelect(select) {
+  if (select.dataset.multiselectInitialized === "true") return;
+
+  select.dataset.multiselectInitialized = "true";
+  select.classList.add("multiselect-native");
+  select.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
+  select.inert = true;
+  select.tabIndex = -1;
+
+  const label = select.labels?.[0];
+  if (label && !label.id) label.id = `${select.id}-label`;
+
+  const multiselect = document.createElement("div");
+  multiselect.className = "multiselect";
+  multiselect.setAttribute("role", "group");
+  if (label?.id) multiselect.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", label.id);
+  if (select.getAttribute("aria-describedby")) multiselect.setAttribute("aria-describedby", select.getAttribute("aria-describedby"));
+  multiselect.innerHTML = `
+    <div class="multiselect__toolbar">
+      <span class="multiselect__count" aria-live="polite"></span>
+      <span class="multiselect__actions">
+        <button class="multiselect__action" type="button" data-multiselect-action="all">Visi</button>
+        <button class="multiselect__action" type="button" data-multiselect-action="clear">Valyti</button>
+      </span>
+    </div>
+    <div class="multiselect__list"></div>`;
+  select.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", multiselect);
+
+  const count = multiselect.querySelector(".multiselect__count");
+  const list = multiselect.querySelector(".multiselect__list");
+  const selectAll = multiselect.querySelector('[data-multiselect-action="all"]');
+  const clear = multiselect.querySelector('[data-multiselect-action="clear"]');
+  let selectedValues = new Set([...select.selectedOptions].map((option) => option.value));
+
+  function syncState() {
+    const options = [...select.options];
+    const selected = options.filter((option) => option.selected);
+    const checkboxes = [...list.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]')];
+
+    checkboxes.forEach((checkbox) => {
+      const option = options.find((item) => item.value === checkbox.value);
+      if (!option) return;
+      checkbox.checked = option.selected;
+      checkbox.disabled = option.disabled;
+    });
+
+    selectedValues = new Set(selected.map((option) => option.value));
+    count.textContent = `${selected.length} iš ${options.length} pasirinkta`;
+    selectAll.disabled = options.length === 0 || options.every((option) => option.disabled || option.selected);
+    clear.disabled = selected.length === 0;
+  }
+
+  function dispatchChange() {
+    syncState();
+    select.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
+  }
+
+  function renderList() {
+    const options = [...select.options];
+    if (!options.some((option) => option.selected) && selectedValues.size) {
+      options.forEach((option) => { option.selected = selectedValues.has(option.value); });
+    }
+
+    list.replaceChildren();
+    if (!options.length) {
+      const empty = document.createElement("p");
+      empty.className = "multiselect__empty";
+      empty.textContent = "Pagal pasirinktus filtrus taškų nėra.";
+      list.append(empty);
+      syncState();
+      return;
+    }
+
+    options.forEach((option) => {
+      const row = document.createElement("label");
+      row.className = "multiselect__option";
+
+      const checkbox = document.createElement("input");
+      checkbox.type = "checkbox";
+      checkbox.value = option.value;
+      checkbox.checked = option.selected;
+      checkbox.disabled = option.disabled;
+      checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => {
+        option.selected = checkbox.checked;
+        dispatchChange();
+      });
+
+      const text = document.createElement("span");
+      text.className = "multiselect__option-text";
+      text.textContent = optionLabel(option);
+      row.append(checkbox, text);
+      list.append(row);
+    });
+
+    syncState();
+  }
+
+  selectAll.addEventListener("click", () => {
+    [...select.options].forEach((option) => { option.selected = !option.disabled; });
+    dispatchChange();
+  });
+  clear.addEventListener("click", () => {
+    [...select.options].forEach((option) => { option.selected = false; });
+    dispatchChange();
+  });
+  select.addEventListener("change", syncState);
+
+  const observer = new MutationObserver(renderList);
+  observer.observe(select, { attributes: true, childList: true, subtree: true });
+  renderList();
+}
+
+export function initMultiSelects(root = document) {
+  root.querySelectorAll("select.select-field[multiple]").forEach(initMultiSelect);
+}

+import io
+import json
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
+
+sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(sys.stdout.buffer, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", line_buffering=True)
+
+BASE = "http://localhost:8000"
+PUBLIC_PAGES = [
+    "/index.html",
+    "/pages/ataskaitos.html",
+    "/pages/bendra-info.html",
+    "/pages/dirvezemis.html",
+    "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html",
+    "/pages/oro.html",
+    "/pages/prenumerata.html",
+    "/pages/privatumo-politika.html",
+    "/pages/slapuku-politika.html",
+    "/pages/truksmas.html",
+    "/pages/vadovas.html",
+    "/pages/vanduo.html",
+    "/pages/zeldynai.html",
+    "/pages/zemelapis.html",
+]
+EXPECTED_NAV = [
+    "Automatinių stotelių duomenys",
+    "Aplinkos triukšmo monitoringas",
+    "Dirvožemio monitoringas",
+    "Paviršinio vandens monitoringas",
+    "Gyvosios gamtos monitoringas",
+    "Želdynų ir želdinių monitoringas",
+]
+
+failures = []
+results = {
+    "deep_links": {},
+    "navigation": {},
+    "multiselects": {},
+    "public_pages": {},
+    "screenshots": {},
+}
+
+
+def check(condition, message):
+    if not condition:
+        failures.append(message)
+
+
+def open_page(context, path, wait_ms=650):
+    page = context.new_page()
+    errors = []
+    page.on("console", lambda message: errors.append(f"console: {message.text}") if message.type == "error" else None)
+    page.on("pageerror", lambda error: errors.append(f"pageerror: {error}"))
+    page.goto(f"{BASE}{path}", wait_until="load")
+    page.wait_for_timeout(wait_ms)
+    return page, errors
+
+
+def selected_values(page, selector):
+    return page.locator(selector).evaluate("select => [...select.selectedOptions].map(option => option.value)")
+
+
+def component_state(page, selector):
+    return page.locator(selector).evaluate(
+        """select => {
+            const component = select.nextElementSibling;
+            return {
+              options: select.options.length,
+              selected: [...select.selectedOptions].map(option => option.value),
+              rows: component?.querySelectorAll('.multiselect__option').length || 0,
+              checked: [...(component?.querySelectorAll('.multiselect__option input:checked') || [])].map(input => input.value),
+              count: component?.querySelector('.multiselect__count')?.textContent || '',
+              visible: Boolean(component && component.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0),
+              nativeWidth: select.getBoundingClientRect().width,
+              inert: select.inert,
+            };
+        }"""
+    )
+
+
+def choose_reducing_district(page, district_selector, sites_selector, initial_count):
+    values = page.locator(district_selector).locator("option").evaluate_all("options => options.map(option => option.value).filter(value => value !== 'all')")
+    for value in values:
+        page.select_option(district_selector, value)
+        page.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        count = page.locator(sites_selector).evaluate("select => select.options.length")
+        if count != initial_count:
+            return {"value": value, "count": count}
+    return None
+
+
+def exercise_multiselect(page, sites_selector, status_selector, chart_selector, table_selector, district_selector=None):
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => document.querySelector(selector)?.nextElementSibling?.classList.contains('multiselect')", arg=sites_selector)
+    initial = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(initial["visible"], f"{sites_selector}: custom list is not visible")
+    check(initial["options"] == initial["rows"], f"{sites_selector}: option/row count mismatch ({initial['options']} / {initial['rows']})")
+    check(sorted(initial["selected"]) == sorted(initial["checked"]), f"{sites_selector}: initial native/custom state differs")
+    check(initial["nativeWidth"] <= 1.1 and initial["inert"], f"{sites_selector}: native select is not visually hidden and inert")
+
+    component = page.locator(f"{sites_selector} + .multiselect")
+    first_checked = component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first
+    before = {
+        "status": page.locator(status_selector).inner_text(),
+        "table_rows": page.locator(f"{table_selector} tbody tr").count(),
+        "chart_sets": page.locator(chart_selector).evaluate("canvas => canvas._kmsChart?.data.datasets.length ?? -1"),
+    }
+    toggled = False
+    if first_checked.count():
+        value = first_checked.get_attribute("value")
+        first_checked.uncheck()
+        page.wait_for_function("([selector, old]) => document.querySelector(selector)?.textContent !== old", arg=[status_selector, before["status"]])
+        after = {
+            "status": page.locator(status_selector).inner_text(),
+            "table_rows": page.locator(f"{table_selector} tbody tr").count(),
+            "chart_sets": page.locator(chart_selector).evaluate("canvas => canvas._kmsChart?.data.datasets.length ?? -1"),
+        }
+        native_after = selected_values(page, sites_selector)
+        check(value not in native_after, f"{sites_selector}: uncheck did not update native select")
+        check(after["table_rows"] != before["table_rows"], f"{sites_selector}: table did not update after uncheck")
+        check(after["chart_sets"] != before["chart_sets"], f"{sites_selector}: chart did not update after uncheck")
+        component.locator(f'.multiselect__option input[value="{value}"]').check()
+        page.wait_for_function("([selector, old]) => document.querySelector(selector)?.textContent === old", arg=[status_selector, before["status"]])
+        toggled = True
+
+    district = None
+    if district_selector:
+        district = choose_reducing_district(page, district_selector, sites_selector, initial["options"])
+        check(district is not None, f"{sites_selector}: district change did not repopulate options")
+        if district:
+            changed = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+            check(changed["options"] == changed["rows"], f"{sites_selector}: option/row mismatch after district change")
+
+    component.locator('[data-multiselect-action="all"]').click()
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => { const s = document.querySelector(selector); return s && [...s.options].filter(o => !o.disabled).every(o => o.selected); }", arg=sites_selector)
+    all_state = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(len(all_state["selected"]) == all_state["options"], f"{sites_selector}: Visi did not select every option")
+
+    component.locator('[data-multiselect-action="clear"]').click()
+    page.wait_for_function("selector => document.querySelector(selector)?.selectedOptions.length === 0", arg=sites_selector)
+    clear_state = component_state(page, sites_selector)
+    check(not clear_state["selected"] and not clear_state["checked"], f"{sites_selector}: Valyti did not clear selection")
+
+    return {
+        "initial": initial,
+        "toggled_chart_and_table": toggled,
+        "district": district,
+        "all_selected": len(all_state["selected"]),
+        "cleared_selected": len(clear_state["selected"]),
+    }
+
+
+with sync_playwright() as playwright:
+    browser = playwright.chromium.launch(headless=True)
+
+    for viewport_name, viewport in (("desktop", {"width": 1440, "height": 900}), ("mobile", {"width": 390, "height": 844})):
+        context = browser.new_context(viewport=viewport, ignore_https_errors=True)
+        if viewport_name == "mobile":
+            context.pages[0].close() if context.pages else None
+
+        oro, oro_errors = open_page(context, "/pages/oro.html#laboratoriniai")
+        oro_state = {
+            "selected": oro.locator("#tab-laboratory-air").get_attribute("aria-selected"),
+            "panel_visible": oro.locator("#panel-laboratory-air").is_visible(),
+            "errors": oro_errors,
+        }
+        check(oro_state["selected"] == "true" and oro_state["panel_visible"], f"oro deep link failed at {viewport_name}")
+        check(not oro_errors, f"oro deep link errors at {viewport_name}: {oro_errors}")
+        oro.evaluate("location.hash = '#nezinomas'")
+        oro.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        check(oro.locator("#tab-automatic-air").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"oro unknown hash did not restore default at {viewport_name}")
+        oro.evaluate("location.hash = '#laboratoriniai'")
+        oro.wait_for_timeout(120)
+        check(oro.locator("#tab-laboratory-air").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"oro hashchange failed at {viewport_name}")
+        results["deep_links"][f"oro_{viewport_name}"] = oro_state
+        oro.close()
+
+        wildlife, wildlife_errors = open_page(context, "/pages/gyvoji_gamta.html#pauksciai")
+        bird_box = wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").bounding_box()
+        wildlife_state = {
+            "selected": wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").get_attribute("aria-selected"),
+            "visible": wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").is_visible(),
+            "in_viewport": bool(bird_box and bird_box["y"] < viewport["height"] and bird_box["y"] + bird_box["height"] > 0),
+            "errors": wildlife_errors,
+        }
+        check(wildlife_state["selected"] == "true" and wildlife_state["visible"] and wildlife_state["in_viewport"], f"wildlife deep link failed at {viewport_name}")
+        check(not wildlife_errors, f"wildlife deep link errors at {viewport_name}: {wildlife_errors}")
+        wildlife.evaluate("location.hash = '#nezinomas'")
+        wildlife.wait_for_timeout(80)
+        check(wildlife.locator("#augalija").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"wildlife unknown hash did not restore first tab at {viewport_name}")
+        wildlife.evaluate("location.hash = '#pauksciai'")
+        wildlife.wait_for_timeout(120)
+        check(wildlife.locator("#pauksciai").get_attribute("aria-selected") == "true", f"wildlife hashchange failed at {viewport_name}")
+        results["deep_links"][f"wildlife_{viewport_name}"] = wildlife_state
+        wildlife.close()
+
+        for path in ("/pages/oro.html", "/pages/prenumerata.html"):
+            nav_page, nav_errors = open_page(context, path, wait_ms=120)
+            nav = nav_page.evaluate(
+                """() => {
+                  const details = [...document.querySelectorAll('.main-nav details')].find(item => item.querySelector(':scope > summary')?.textContent.includes('Monitoringas'));
+                  return [...details.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul > li > a')].map(link => ({ text: link.textContent.trim(), href: link.getAttribute('href') }));
+                }"""
+            )
+            check(len(nav) == 6, f"{path}: expected 6 monitoring links, found {len(nav)} at {viewport_name}")
+            check([item["text"] for item in nav] == EXPECTED_NAV, f"{path}: monitoring link texts/order differ at {viewport_name}: {nav}")
+            check(all("#" not in item["href"] for item in nav), f"{path}: tab-switch hash link remains at {viewport_name}")
+            check(not nav_errors, f"{path}: navigation page errors at {viewport_name}: {nav_errors}")
+            results["navigation"][f"{Path(path).stem}_{viewport_name}"] = nav
+            nav_page.close()
+        context.close()
+
+    desktop = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900}, ignore_https_errors=True)
+    water, water_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/vanduo.html")
+    results["multiselects"]["water"] = exercise_multiselect(water, "#water-sites", "[data-role='status']", "[data-chart='main']", "[data-role='table']", "#water-district")
+    check(not water_errors, f"water errors: {water_errors}")
+    screenshot_dir = Path(tempfile.gettempdir())
+    water_desktop_shot = screenshot_dir / "kms-batch-a-water-desktop.png"
+    water.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").screenshot(path=str(water_desktop_shot))
+    results["screenshots"]["water_desktop"] = str(water_desktop_shot)
+    water.close()
+
+    oro, oro_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/oro.html#laboratoriniai")
+    for selector in ("#air-sites", "#lab-sites"):
+        state = component_state(oro, selector)
+        check(state["options"] == state["rows"] and state["visible"], f"{selector}: oro list did not mirror native options")
+        check(sorted(state["selected"]) == sorted(state["checked"]), f"{selector}: oro native/custom state differs")
+        results["multiselects"][selector] = state
+    lab_component = oro.locator("#lab-sites + .multiselect")
+    if lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').count():
+        lab_value = lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first.get_attribute("value")
+        lab_component.locator('.multiselect__option input:checked').first.uncheck()
+        check(lab_value not in selected_values(oro, "#lab-sites"), "oro laboratory checkbox did not sync native select")
+    check(not oro_errors, f"oro multiselect errors: {oro_errors}")
+    oro.close()
+
+    greenery, greenery_errors = open_page(desktop, "/pages/zeldynai.html")
+    results["multiselects"]["greenery"] = exercise_multiselect(greenery, "#greenery-sites", "#greenery-status", "#greenery-chart", "#greenery-table", "#greenery-district")
+    check(not greenery_errors, f"greenery errors: {greenery_errors}")
+    greenery.close()
+    desktop.close()
+
+    mobile_visual = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 390, "height": 844}, ignore_https_errors=True)
+    water_mobile, mobile_errors = open_page(mobile_visual, "/pages/vanduo.html")
+    water_mobile.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").scroll_into_view_if_needed()
+    water_mobile_shot = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "kms-batch-a-water-mobile.png"
+    water_mobile.locator("#water-sites + .multiselect").screenshot(path=str(water_mobile_shot))
+    results["screenshots"]["water_mobile"] = str(water_mobile_shot)
+    check(not mobile_errors, f"water mobile errors: {mobile_errors}")
+    water_mobile.close()
+    mobile_visual.close()
+
+    for viewport_name, viewport in (("desktop", {"width": 1440, "height": 900}), ("mobile", {"width": 390, "height": 844})):
+        context = browser.new_context(viewport=viewport, ignore_https_errors=True)
+        page_results = {}
+        for path in PUBLIC_PAGES:
+            page, errors = open_page(context, path, wait_ms=350)
+            width = page.evaluate("document.documentElement.scrollWidth")
+            page_results[path] = {"scrollWidth": width, "errors": errors}
+            if viewport_name == "desktop":
+                check(not errors, f"{path}: desktop console/page errors: {errors}")
+            if viewport_name == "mobile":
+                check(width <= 396, f"{path}: mobile scrollWidth is {width}px")
+            page.close()
+        results["public_pages"][viewport_name] = page_results
+        context.close()
+
+    browser.close()
+
+results["failures"] = failures
+results["summary"] = {
+    "failure_count": len(failures),
+    "desktop_error_count": sum(len(item["errors"]) for item in results["public_pages"]["desktop"].values()),
+    "mobile_max_scroll_width": max(item["scrollWidth"] for item in results["public_pages"]["mobile"].values()),
+}
+print(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
+raise SystemExit(1 if failures else 0)

   return { ...rangeForPeriod(period, DEMO_NOW), resolution: "daily" };
